name: Albescent-Hamada
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are perpetual storm systems, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
Whoever abandoned the ancient alien ruins did so in order: power first, then data, then people. The airlocks were cycled from the inside, gently, one last time.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
